#### Core Innovation
The research introduces a predictive model to identify potential customer support (CS) needs in Airbnb's two-sided marketplace by analyzing host and guest behavior. By integrating this model into the search ranking algorithm, Airbnb can optimize match quality, reduce CS support incidents, and enhance user satisfaction.

#### Technical Approach
